card.name: Words just before a needed action or measure
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words (the, adequate, to, maintain, complete, with) that come right before a physical, corrective or supportive action or condition in instructions. The pattern is loose and spans several settings.

modes.label: Before adequacy or support terms
modes.description: The word 'adequate' or a verb just before something to be ensured or maintained, such as hydration or an airway.
modes.example: administer QIVIGY at the minimum dose and infusion rate practicable. Ensure<< adequate>> hydration in patients before administration.

modes.label: Before a physical or alignment action
modes.description: A linking word before a mechanical, physical or corrective step such as alignment or massage.
modes.example: or because of the lack of binocular motor fusion to stabilize<< the>> alignment.

modes.label: Before a recommended step
modes.description: A verb or 'to' in advice about what to do next, such as warm compresses or surgery.
modes.example: the doctor may<< recommend>> that the tear duct be opened surgically

card.plain: It marks a spot where the text is about to name a physical fix or a needed supportive step.
